# Wave 2B2A scope

## Rebuilt here

- Exact recovered C7X v1.0.1 full selected-panel targeted-memory analysis. Its
  primary is retained as not estimable because the benefactor arm has 125 rows,
  below the frozen 1,000-per-arm threshold.
- Exact recovered C7R v1.0.2 first/repeat and relationship closure (19 models).
- Duplicate-order recovery, same-speed, exclusive-history, recency,
  tie-independent, nontournament, and ply-over-10 variants already defined by
  those frozen producers.

## Authority treatment

The certified pool/non-adjacent panel is the sole focal sample. The Wave 2B1
pair histories are authenticated and reused. Historical 2% cells are retained
as diagnostics because equality with the former sample is neither expected nor
scientifically meaningful. Because C7X has no selected-panel primary estimate,
C7R's same-run numerical reproduction gate is not applicable. The independent
C7R first/repeat family runs normally. Its C7X-relationship attempts are
retained under C7R's frozen all-attempts rule and labeled as low-support,
post-gate exploratory diagnostics.

## Still open after this run

- Frequent-dyad census sensitivity on the new C7X classification.
- Campaign C1/C6/C9/C12/C13 recovery and the remaining family-wide/ply
  reconciliation (Wave 2B2B).
- Patron matching and heterogeneity (Wave 3).
- Unified manuscript tables, figures, abstract count, and final section 5–6
  authority ledger.
